summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing minutes of an extraordinary general meeting held on July 2, 2026. At the meeting, shareholders representing 95.56% of voting capital voted to fix the Board of Directors at twelve members and to elect two new independent board members for a supplementary term until the 2027 annual meeting. While this is a board election, it appears to be a routine governance action rather than a forced or abrupt management change. The filing does not disclose a special-situations catalyst, a transaction, or an activist campaign. Because the election is presented as a supplementary term in the ordinary course, this filing does not rise to the level of a material special situation.
